scope: audit the next generic source-document read-batch continuation and its upstream-to-CLI ownership boundary

migrationDecision.reason: The read-batch continuation currently returns a caller-selected generic Result, while the terminal ControllerInvocationManifest contract is CLI-owned. Replacing the generic result with a CLI manifest type in core would invert package ownership. A safe migration first needs a named shared terminal-outcome contract or a domain-specific operation boundary that preserves the core-to-CLI dependency direction.
migrationDecision.requiredNextDesignStep: Model the source-read batch terminal outcome as an explicit shared domain contract, or establish a CLI-owned continuation adapter that consumes variant-specific core operations without adding a reverse dependency.

preservedSemantics: Complete documents remain distinct from blocked reads.
Partial documents and every blocker must remain available on blocked batches.
The CLI manifest terminal contract remains owned by the CLI package.
Identity-bound and identity-rejected batch evidence remains distinct.
notVerified: PHP source to CLI manifest to generator end-to-end execution
